desc:
Along a trail, spot i has a beauty score scores[i]. You choose two spots i < j to visit. The value of the pair is the sum of the two scores minus the distance between them:

scores[i] + scores[j] - (j - i)

Return the maximum value over all pairs.

Example: scores = [8, 1, 5, 2, 6] returns 11, from spots 0 and 2: 8 + 5 - 2.
hints: Trying all pairs is O(n<sup>2</sup>). Rewrite the value so that the part depending on i and the part depending on j are separate.
Scan j from left to right while keeping the maximum of scores[i] + i over all earlier i. At each j the best pair ending at j is that maximum plus scores[j] - j.
editorial: The value splits into (scores[i] + i) + (scores[j] - j). For a fixed j, only the first bracket depends on i, and we want it as large as possible over all i < j. That is a prefix maximum.
Initialise left = scores[0] + 0. For each j from 1 to n - 1, update best = max(best, left + scores[j] - j) and then left = max(left, scores[j] + j). The order matters: j must not pair with itself.
O(n) time and O(1) space. The largest possible answer is just under 2 * 10<sup>9</sup>, which still fits in a signed 32-bit integer.
